claims.claim: A change in satellite sensors can make historical fire activity appear to increase or decrease even when the underlying activity has not changed proportionally.
claims.supported_by: Task 05 raw scale gap: VIIRS reference mean 8.27 vs MODIS Terra 0.49 / Aqua 0.58 per district-day.
claims.required_qualification: detections are observations, not fire counts

claims.claim: Harmonization transforms MODIS observations to a VIIRS-equivalent scale.
claims.supported_by: Court CCC 0.52-0.63; residual bias reported per method.
claims.required_qualification: VIIRS-equivalent estimate only; VIIRS is not ground truth; agreement is partial (CCC ~0.5-0.63) and district-dependent.

claims.claim: The winning harmonization method is [method X].
claims.supported_by: Court decision: inconclusive (overlapping CIs, district instability).
claims.required_qualification: No method may be presented as validated winner.

claims.supported_by: Seam audit residual steps 0.8-2.1 after correction.
claims.required_qualification: reduces a documented scale mismatch; residual differences remain.

claims.supported_by: FIRMS documentation; multiple detections can belong to one fire.
Pipeline status vocabulary keeps observed_zero, missing, unavailable distinct.

claims.claim: District-level results are equally reliable everywhere.
claims.supported_by: Spatial robustness: Chitwan CCC 0.19-0.34 vs Banke/Bardiya ~0.6.
claims.required_qualification: Chitwan harmonized results are use-with-caution or insufficient at stratum level.

claims.claim: A satellite transition caused an observed change in fire activity.
claims.required_qualification: never state causality from the seam diagnostic.

claims.supported_by: No forecasting component exists in the project.
claims.required_qualification: the project harmonizes historical observations; it does not predict fires.

claims.supported_by: Project is an independent Space Apps Challenge entry using public NASA data.
claims.required_qualification: attribute data to NASA FIRMS/LANCE; never imply endorsement.
